Celebrating 30 years, Inforlandia presents itself with a deep knowledge and experience in the technological sector, at local and international level, with successes that speak for themselves. Today it is the largest manufacturer of computer equipment in Portugal, with an offer adjusted and developed to the needs of customers and with a strong weight in exports. The ambition that dictated its path continues to outline its growth and consolidation strategies. With the aim of making technology increasingly accessible, both for Education and for the business and public sectors, it has been developing production methods and strategies that ensure unmatched flexibility and high levels of quality, with the utmost efficiency. The commitment to quality has been rewarded with certifications at the highest level, and Inforlandia’s objective is to continue to be one of the national companies with the highest number of product, process and business-level certifications.
It has ISO 9001 quality certifications; environmental ISO 14001; social responsibility SA 8000, ecology and sustainability EPEAT and TCO and Energy Star energy efficiency. Inforlandia is specialized in the production of customized series using internally developed and patented production technologies.
Since 1990, Inforlandia has developed, designed, manufactured and custom tailored personal computers, servers, tablets, smartphones and other consumer electronic products, under its brands (INSYS, Matrixx), on an EMS/ODM basis for large worldwide clients under Private Label brands. Market leader in several segments, namely, being the largest manufacturer in South Europe of mainstream notebook computers and smart phones.
Inforlandia R&D patented several innovative solutions, currently embedded in several of its products, namely the “CUCo security”, an anti-theft and contract compliance technology for remote hardware device lockdown and “EduPro” devices for teachers, education and schools.
Inforlandia has a robust financial structure with registered capital of €20M (≈$19M) and a low debt/assets ratio. With up to 100 employees, 20% with a University degree, has topped yearly sales of €127M (≈$125M). We are part of a large industrial group (VAGA) that reaches combined sales in excess of €200M (≈$300M) per year (>1000 employees).

a. MIDEST (Mining, raw materials)
b. WIDEST (waste, recycling, urban mining)
c. VIDEST (New Short Distance Industry, New Space Industry, Vertical High Rice Industry)
d. AIDEST (Architecture Investment Design)
e. UXDEST (User Oriented City Design)
f. HRDEST (Human Resource Design)
Through the six areas, we can create innovative overall concepts in master plans that consider various innovation aspects in context. Through precise analysis, we look at the initial situation of the region, the potentials, dangers and weaknesses and work out a vision together with the client, which, through concrete strategies for action, timetables and cost plans, form the basis for the investment plans. Investor partners receive the necessary clear overview of the project parameters, qualities and quantities.

MSAO EST ensures a reliable investment policy combined with innovation diplomacy. 
MSAO has extensive experience in the negotiation, development and design of large regional, industrial and infrastructure projects. We are partners for governments in Germany and abroad. As architects and engineers, we combine design and technology to create innovation projects with visionary appeal as state-of-the-art projects.

HUN-REN Research Centre for Natural Sciences (HUN-REN RCNS) is an organisational unit of HUN-REN Hungarian Research Network (a legal entity performing a public service function with a special legal status) and has a legal personality of its own. As a non-profit organisational unit of HUN-REN, RCNS qualifies as a research institution (a research and knowledge dissemination organisation), conducting multidisciplinary research in the natural sciences, including both the life sciences and the physical sciences. HUN-REN RCNS is entitled to apply for grants in its own name as well as receive grant funding and enter into contracts.
The HUN-REN Research Centre for Natural Sciences carries out multidisciplinary research in natural sciences in the fields of cognitive neuroscience and psychology, enzymology, organic chemistry, as well as materials- and environmental chemistry. Research Centre for Basic psychological research is performed both for pure scientific purposes and for direct or indirect application in Hungary. Research areas cover social, comparative cultural, cognitive and developmental psychology and psychophysiology. Research takes a broad approach to scientific issues, and embraces other branches of science and social science. Research centre staff is also engaged in adapting and developing new psychological research methods. Vocational and basic education at both undergraduate and postgraduate level is another area where research centre staff is active.

Digit Soil is a team of experts in soil science, biotechnology, agronomy, and software engineering that aims to revolutionize agriculture and regenerate soils. Our company is built on the conviction that farmers need accurate and directly interpretable information to farm sustainably, starting with indication on the optimal amount, type, and timing of fertilizer application to improve their efficiency and foster the use of organic fertilizer. 
At Digit Soil, we have developed a technology that provides farmers with the information they need to optimize the use of both synthetic and organic fertilizers. entityName: Institute of Advanced Materials, IAAM AB
entityDescription:
The Institute of Advanced Materials (IAM) is a hub of innovation and research dedicated to harnessing the potential of materials science, engineering and technology for a variety of industries. Since its inception, IAM has been at the forefront of materials innovations, working to develop and promote cutting-edge research that can be translated into practical applications with real-world benefits.

IAM's mission is rooted in the belief that advancements in new age technology are key to solving some of the most pressing challenges facing humanity, from clean energy production to environmental sustainability and healthcare. By focusing on translational research, IAM strives to bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and their implementation in products and technologies that can improve quality of life.

The institute is not only a research entity but also a consultancy body, offering expertise in R&D, technology transfer, and infrastructural development. This ensures that research outcomes do not remain confined to academic papers but evolve into tangible, commercially viable, and significant products that serve the end-user.

IAM's global reach is expanded through its network of partnerships and collaborations with some of the world’s leading researchers, institutes, and scientists. This collaborative environment fosters a culture of innovation and a multidisciplinary approach to problem-solving, which is essential in the complex field of materials science and technology.

The areas of focus for IAM include, but are not limited to, energy—where the development of new innovation for energy, climate technology and health are crucial; environment—where new materials and digital technology can play a role in pollution control and sustainable resource management; and health—where innovative materials can lead to advanced medical devices and drug delivery systems.

Sanzar is a private Spanish entity founded in 2019 whose activity sector is aerospace and agro-tech, specifically oriented to the design and integration of control systems for aerospace vehicles. In space, we can provide specific control for agile satellites with high angular speeds (3-6º/s) through an innovative patented configuration. This solution will reduce the control weight of the satellite (>100%) and increase its manoeuvrability (>75%), allowing more efficient operations in manoeuvres, such as adjusting cameras and other satellite observation objects. In the case of air vehicles will enable them to operate where aircraft are currently limited, increasing manoeuvrability by more than 50% and allowing them to operate in conditions of low or no speed and short takeoffs. In the Precision Agriculture sector, it sells software for the reduction and optimal recommendation in applying fertilisers using automatic learning models, improving the sustainability and yield of crops. Today, we are in Europe, South America and North Africa. Experts, universities and research institutions validate our services. We have experience in European programs such as INNOWWIDE (Eureka), NEOTEC (marketing of aerospace control HW), ICEX NEXT (internationalisation) and ESA BIC (European space agency incubation) with a public-private investment of €900,000 for the last 2 years and a turnover of €100K in 2021.
